verdict.rationale: Honeybadger does not document a general scheduler for user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. It does have recurring, platform-run automation: Alarms re-evaluate a BadgerQL query against a threshold over rolling windows, and uptime checks repeatedly hit your endpoints. Check-ins only monitor cron jobs that you schedule elsewhere. Missing for 10: a user-configurable scheduler for arbitrary jobs/workflows, cron-style schedule definitions via API/CLI/MCP, scheduled reports or recurring query exports, and independent corroboration.
